name: Canh chua kho ca loc
summary: A sour soup of dried snakehead, soured gently with tamarind and filled out with pineapple and greens, the fish still sweet.
origin: Đồng Tháp Mười, in the old Long An half of Tây Ninh. Dried snakehead from kênh 79 is the base of the plate.
taste: Mild tamarind sourness, pineapple, greens, and sweet dried fish.
howToEat: Eat it with rice, beside the other dried-snakehead plates.
where: The drying yards along kênh 79 and the markets that sell khô cá lóc, plus orchard and countryside tourism stops.
seoTitle: Canh chua kho ca loc in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Canh chua khô cá lóc, a mild tamarind soup of dried snakehead with pineapple.
